text:
alice: heads-up: ap-southeast1 nvme pool hitting sustained small-write IOPS bursts since 03:20 UTC, we've seen 8 GPU attach failures in the last 10m. @ben can you confirm metrics?
ops-bot: ALERT ap-southeast1 nvme_iops_small_write 75% > threshold for 5m (hosts: nvme-pool-12..15) :rotating_light:
ben: looking, pulling iostat + provisioning logs now. I see write latency tail climbing, scheduler backlog up. attaching short logs in a sec.
dave: pasted nvme stats: ```nvme smart-log /dev/nvme0n1
temperature: 43C
data_units_written: 342,198
data_units_read: 10,442
write_iops_1m: 18k
avg_write_latency_ms: 12.6
ioerr_count: 0
```
carol: likely janitor/cleanup overlap with a couple of large training jobs causing a lot of tiny fsyncs. we've seen this pattern before — janitor concurrency + small-writes = hotstripes + wear pressure. short-term options: 1) throttle janitor concurrency in region 2) cordon a few batch racks and reroute jobs 3) raise scrub interval temporarily (less aggressive)
maya: cost note — rerouting to different region increases egress + GPU ops cost; dedicated capacity will also cost more. throttling janitor is cheapest immediate mitigation. if we cordon and requeue, compute ops might delay customer SLAs.
leo: oncall: I can throttle janitor flags now and watch attach errors drop. suggestion: reduce janitor workers from 8->2 for 30m and pause batch-scheduler for ap-southeast1 for 20m.
ben: agree. quick command to flip feature flag: ```curl -X POST "https://infra-api.internal/flags/janitor/concurrency" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"region":"ap-southeast1","workers":2}'``` then disable batch scheduling: ```curl -X POST "https://scheduler.internal/region/pause" -d '{"region":"ap-southeast1","duration_mins":20}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"```
dave: after throttle iostat shows write_iops_1m drop to ~6k within 2 minutes typically, and GPU attach failure rate should fall. still need to follow up on wear metrics — I will kick a background SMART re-scan on the affected nodes. cmd: `ansible -i hosts-ap-southeast1 -m shell -a "nvme-cli smart-log /dev/nvme* > /var/log/nvme-smarts/$(date +%s).log"`
carol: runbook reminder: update runbook step 4 to include "if small-write iops > 12k and attach_failures > 5 within 10m -> throttle janitor, pause scheduler, notify infra-sre". I'll make the PR after stabilization.
alice: decision: throttle janitor now, pause batch-scheduler for 20m, keep monitoring. ben/leo do the flips, dave kick the SMART scan. maya raise cost/impact note to finance for potential reroute costs if we need region failover. create follow-up ticket TICKET-3421 for long-term: investigate small-write mitigation (io coalescing, janitor rewrite, per-pool eviction limits).
ben: done — flags applied, scheduler paused. monitoring graphs look better already, attach errors back to baseline.
leo: oncall leaving note: will monitor for 60m and escalate to rotations if errors return. :thumbsup:
alice: thanks everyone — we'll reconvene in channel if anything regresses.
